t: Azure DevOps Services Pricing | Microsoft Azure
s: Each Azure DevOps organization gets one parallel job with 1,800 minutes (30 hours) of build time every month using Microsoft-hosted agents. If you need more time or would like to run more than one job at a time, simply buy the number of pipelines you need. When you buy your first Microsoft-hosted pipeline, the number of parallel jobs in the organization remains at one; this purchase removes only the time limit on the free pipeline.
